**Stored-center diagnosis delivered; physical public qualification remains open.**

The [joint six-case review](https://github.com/uibcdf/topomt/blob/06657e5855b9fe117aa11abe57be41a6cf6d470f/docs/content/benchlab/synthetic/six_case_review.md) receives 19 actual public profiles at scientific/helper source `1510e007d96da8a3c569f626a1b263fb59a54533`, without changing native operators or promotion. All 355 original non-Markdown case/download files are preserved.

At narrow 2.5 Å, all 24 WET-1 and six WET-2 resident centers are blocked by nonlocal atoms; connector-only WET-3 remains native-only. At wide 5 Å, the single resident center is likewise blocked. Local values recompute correctly and stored centers satisfy the declared support check. Narrow tetrahedron 64: local clearance 7.016483499 Å versus all-atom -0.358693175 Å (atom 31). Wide tetrahedron 115: 5.299843470 Å versus -1.575928567 Å (atom 24).

This explains these point observations, not general solver completeness or an arithmetic defect. Complete finite-hull exclusion still comes from the independent covers. A blocked local center does not alone exclude another free point in its carrier, and one clear point does not establish a path/component/morphology. The diagnostic guards include that distinction, source maps, nondefault units, margins, degenerate supports, work refusal and both actual public exclusion profiles.

**Next under this issue:** decide and implement the explicit all-atom public qualification/promotion contract while preserving the local substrate and honest unresolved states. The empty-public xfail remains a proposed policy, not an independent oracle for the local bank. Broader supports/paths remain #60/#76.

[Updated report](https://github.com/uibcdf/topomt/blob/06657e5855b9fe117aa11abe57be41a6cf6d470f/devguide/pending_proposals/dfnd_tube_all_atom_receiving.md) · [Full retained capture, protocol and reproduction](https://github.com/uibcdf/topomt/blob/06657e5855b9fe117aa11abe57be41a6cf6d470f/docs/content/benchlab/synthetic/artifacts/six_case_review_v1/README.md) · [Diagnostic guards](https://github.com/uibcdf/topomt/blob/06657e5855b9fe117aa11abe57be41a6cf6d470f/tests/test_benchlab_residence_witnesses.py).

One CPU/thread, 4 GiB address-space ceiling, 17.02 s and peak 336484 KiB RSS for the full capture. Finding lifecycle remains `needs_review`; no comparative, biological, installed-package or general DFND failure claim.

**Guard wording corrected; original five-domain physical diagnosis remains open.**

The [joint six-case review](https://github.com/uibcdf/topomt/blob/06657e5855b9fe117aa11abe57be41a6cf6d470f/docs/content/benchlab/synthetic/six_case_review.md) renames the misleading test to `test_retained_dumbbell_domain_counts_increase_with_probe` and corrects its module introduction. The native numerical assertion is retained and the renamed guard passes. No scientific operator or monotone-count constraint changes.

The 1.4/2.2 Å named-anchor references and provisional hierarchy retain their original scope; they do not diagnose all five original 2.0 Å domains. This issue still owns inspection of those exact supports, independent physical references, and the legacy direct-array/scalar units, epsilon and source maps before comparing with quantity-aware public receiving. The finding remains `needs_review`.

[Updated owner report](https://github.com/uibcdf/topomt/blob/06657e5855b9fe117aa11abe57be41a6cf6d470f/devguide/pending_proposals/dfnd_component_count_diagnosis.md) · [Retained test](https://github.com/uibcdf/topomt/blob/06657e5855b9fe117aa11abe57be41a6cf6d470f/tests/test_dfnd_pathological.py). Closing the bounded joint review #187 does not close this scientific question.

**Bounded six-case review completed in source 06657e5855b9fe117aa11abe57be41a6cf6d470f.**

[Public disposition and 19-profile table](https://github.com/uibcdf/topomt/blob/06657e5855b9fe117aa11abe57be41a6cf6d470f/docs/content/benchlab/synthetic/six_case_review.md) · [Archived review record](https://github.com/uibcdf/topomt/blob/06657e5855b9fe117aa11abe57be41a6cf6d470f/devguide/archive/benchlab_six_case_review.md) · [Full retained capture and reproduction](https://github.com/uibcdf/topomt/blob/06657e5855b9fe117aa11abe57be41a6cf6d470f/docs/content/benchlab/synthetic/artifacts/six_case_review_v1/README.md).

The six frozen inputs are received through the actual public API at capture producer `1510e007d96da8a3c569f626a1b263fb59a54533`. Existing native/public support, partitions, reciprocal coasts, depth and parent checks pass. All 355 original non-Markdown case/download files are byte-identical. Sixteen retained executed notebooks and all 1513 file hashes in the four current ZIP manifests are checked; no new kernel or hosted-download execution is claimed.

The table distinguishes independent geometry, native banks, catalog promotion, physical boundary availability, quantities and provisional hierarchy. The tube point diagnosis identifies nonlocal blocking for all 31 excluded-profile resident centers without alleging a local arithmetic solver error or replacing the independent whole-hull covers. #181 remains active for physical public qualification; #180/#184 retain boundary availability, #188 five-domain interpretation, and #60/#76/#16 their broader gates.

Validation: 10 focused scientific/record tests plus 16 reporting/finding tests pass under bounded `--noconftest --receptor=llm` selections; repository Ruff/format and scoped helper mypy pass. Full strict one-worker Sphinx succeeds with zero warnings; rendered validation checks 114 HTML pages, 11164 local links and byte-identifies the four new review downloads. Native capture used one CPU, 17.02 s and peak 336484 KiB RSS.

Guard: `tests/test_benchlab_six_case_review.py::test_review_receipt_retains_frozen_models_and_actual_public_profiles` protects review coverage, provenance, saved outcomes and original inputs. It does not certify universal DFND correctness. Current method/case summaries and Discussions #129/#130/#154 are reconciled; interpretation cards remain `needs_review`.

Closing this review establishes its traceable disposition and correction order. It does not fix the open scientific issues, select another geometry/provider/protein phase, qualify an installed matrix or deploy the new review page. Commits carry `[skip ci]`; no remote CI is inferred.
